title: Runs from halted configurations stay fixed
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine and let $c$ be a configuration on a fixed input whose state is empty. For every choice word $w$, the run of $M$ from $c$ under $w$ equals $c$.
hypotheses_covered: nondeterministic machine M with k work tapes
configuration c on a fixed input
replaced:
Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine and $c$ a configuration of $M$ on
some input whose state component is empty (the machine has halted).  Then for every choice
word $w$, running $M$ from $c$ under $w$ yields $c$ itself.
